Coming down to Canberra in real life this Monday! I'll be chatting to local legend @Virginia_Hauss at ANU about how #MeToo has changed Australia, & how the reckoning over sexual violence & power has accelerated. Event is free - you just need to register 
https://t.co/vUIFsWMbwe

@ClimateHuman @GretaThunberg To analogise, if women had just remained afraid of rape and sexual assault, we would never have had #MeToo and, well, the entire history of feminism. Anger has, for better or worse, been a driving force, and has precipitated enormous cultural change on this front.
Here at @adelwritersweek and starting early with these legends - @MichaelWestBiz, @Scottludlam and Tom Wright - talking about Ukraine, oligarchs, #MeToo and revolutions https://t.co/ArxtNv3gTU
An honour to talk to @sababebawi last week for IWD about #MeToo (and the conditions that created it), and how it has changed Australia
